_comment: Deployment-only artifact manifest (never tracked binaries). Pinned defaults live in this file and scripts/prepare_gms_host_tools.sh; configs/runtime.json or environment variables override per deployment (e.g. an access-controlled mirror). See README.md in this directory.

jdk-11.role: fallback Java runtime for older CTS/GTS tools (jadx wrapper)

provision.verification: mandatory SHA-256; tarball must contain exactly one bin/java plus release/legal metadata; installed runtime must report Java major 11
